column3: Shirley near Jason's house, Key Lento; buy Salty Squid rum at Three Sheets Liquor.
column4:
After Gear Up / Lab Fees / Just a Scratch / Unwanted Attention, help Shirley before Tourist Trap. Buy rum BEFORE asking the shop about strange bird noises (the exotic-animal shootout can shut it). Return to Shirley for reported Focus/criminal-profile benefit. Chapter 1 MISSABLE.
Nearby hoop lead (Key Lento): Brian’s Boat Works & Marina; compare the Three Sheets Liquor marker before marking it.
Reported Focus increase: 3% (Act of Kindness).
Shirley’s strand is not part of Strangers & Freaks.

column3: The Rusty Anchor, Key Lento. Cal texts after Day Release, before Swamped.
column4: Say yes to drinks with Cal and Rhonda, then DRIVE CAL HOME. Declining twice or abandoning him fails. Later Cal texts: the bar sells a white Rusty Anchor T-shirt and cap. Chapter 1 ONLY; reward is the option to BUY clothes. GPS map: Rusty Anchor bar venue for the optional mission.

column3: Shirley's neighbor Peggy's house across the water in Key Lento; scooter beside the driveway stairs.
column4: After Get Shirley's Rum, wait roughly a day for Shirley to call Jason. Take Peggy's scooter and drive it inside Shirley's porch/house. Chapter 1 ONLY: unavailable at Tourist Trap. No reward reported.\nShirley’s strand is not part of Strangers & Freaks.

column3: Gellhorn Outfitters on west Port Gellhorn beachside.
column4: Lucia gets this automatic side mission after Girls' Trip. Retrieve weapons already stored in locker (free), or buy a gun. Walk out armed to finish; no separate cash reward. GPS map: Gellhorn Outfitters store venue for the optional mission.\nScorpio Nipper.38 costs $495 if you have no stored weapon.

column3: Read pilot flyer beside Starlet Motel office, then go to McKittrick Farm about a mile east.
column4: Lucia: (1) fly Kyle's crop duster over field, three passes ($400 reported); (2) obtain chemicals from guarded compound ($1,000 reported); (3) finish Buddy? police standoff in Chapter 2 or later ($5,000 reported if helping police). Later steps arrive by text; payouts depend on choices. For the chemical delivery, wait for Kyle's text then visit FarmFix on Chastity Avenue north of Belville. Inspect the van. Negotiate > Pay less > Pay now costs $3,000; Negotiate > Pay Later > Give Collateral uses Kyle's plane and costs nothing upfront. Drive the van into the barn by the silo. Eat the offered strawberry for the reported max stamina upgrade; later berries give temporary effects. $1,000 payment is separate. GPS map: Starlet Motel flyer starting point; McKittrick Farm is a separate destination.\nAfter the third stage, a further Farm Fix visit is reported without a text or mission marker.\nBuddy? finale: either protagonist can attend. It may unlock during Chapter 2 after a long wait. Both outcomes count toward Strangers & Freaks; siding with police reportedly pays $5,000, while waiting for Kyle to win pays nothing.

column3: Northern Lummox County near Mount Kalaga; Jason receives Bret text after Coffee Break.
column4: JASON ONLY. Meet Bret alone after Coffee Break; take the Killtelligence SM-69. Study and track deer, aim for head or heart for Good or Pristine carcass quality, and transport kills by truck. Bret texts each Target Deck after the prior delivery; see Activities > Bret Target Decks for documented hunts. First reward ~$500 reported. After Veteran Hunted, watch for Bret's rare-animal clues in Activities > Snapmatic Animals. See the Legendary Animals checklist for nine clue hunts and two other rare creatures. Use Focus (L3+R3) to inspect vitals, best weapon and value; Bret buys whole carcasses after this mission. Green dollar icon indicates available drop-off.\nFair Game is Bret’s separate trophy; his strand is not part of Strangers & Freaks.

column3: Salton, Vice City: after Bumper to Bumper and Yago's delayed text; Jason only.
column4: TIME-LIMITED pink hourglass. Meet Santiago, select Freeway Run (second race), rent a car, finish race against Yago. First-place payout reported $3,800, varies by finish. DO THIS promptly when text arrives; a side race before Brother to Brother; do not assume it is required for the trophy. Separate from initial Join a Street Race. GPS map: Salton street-race venue; select the timed Freeway Run event.\nReported story-order trigger: after Raul’s Next Job; do not wait if the hourglass appears earlier.\nJason only; after Bumper to Bumper and Yago’s message. Reported: the race missable and Alcast excludes it from required trophy tasks; complete promptly if collecting all optional tasks.

column3: Sundown Private Airfield, Leonard County. Pete calls Jason after Pool Day.
column4:
Jason only. Passing the Torch: enter the hangar backroom through the red door; take Pete's KZ-59 from the table. Safe code 3718. Make three drops and return the aircraft to the airstrip south of Port Gellhorn. $12,000.
Backseat Pilot: Wild Hog Airfield; Dodo seaplane. Collect the cargo alongside the supplier boat, complete seven drops by midnight (two in-game hours), then return.
Hostile Takeover: Southpoint Airfield; Mammatus. Land in the supplier field, collect the bag during the shootout and make seven drops by 20:00.
Stormy Weather: Avery Allen & Co.; Dodo. Land alongside the supplier boat, collect the cargo and make seven drops by 14:00. Allow extra room for turns in the storm.
Over and Out: Sundown Private Airfield; Mammatus. Opens a few days after both middle jobs. Land near the supplier, collect cargo and make seven drops by 08:00.
The middle jobs can be completed in either order. Each timed run pays $20,000 for all seven deliveries; return the aircraft to finish. Total possible payout $92,000. Complete the fifth job for Strangers & Freaks.

column3: Thrillbilly Mud Club, north Kelly County
column4:
Begin Billy strand: Check Out the Mud Club; unlocks other Mud Club races. GPS map: Thrillbilly Mud Club venue; meet Billy to start the mission.
Selecting the Mud Club during Coffee Break can start Thrillbillies as a main mission.
Reported placement-dependent cash, up to $2,500 for first place.
Billy’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Hometown Heroes awards The Lone Rider.

column3: Port Gellhorn. Wait for Billy to contact you after Thrillbillies.
column4: Join Billy with either character and follow his crew on the dirt bike. Finish the armored van job and follow Billy back. Reported payout $2,000.\nBilly’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Hometown Heroes awards The Lone Rider.

column3: Behind the Malibu, Ocean Beach. Wait for Billy to contact you in Chapter 3 after Twist Wrist.
column4:
Bring Jason or Lucia solo. Follow Billy into the jewelry store and leave in the van. Reported payout $12,000. This is a story job with Billy.
Reported story-order appearance after The Missing Link.
Billy’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Hometown Heroes awards The Lone Rider.
Optional outfit retention (community report): before leaving the mission area, visit the clothing store near the start while still wearing Billy’s biker outfit. If the wardrobe preview removes it, equip purchased glasses and preview a shirt without equipping it; then attempt to save the outfit. If the game reports unowned items, change the shoes and helmet and retry. Patch-sensitive; keep a separate save.

column3: Ambrosia Police Department impound, Kelly County.
column4: After Mall Rats, wait for Billy to call, then reply to Wyman's text. Take the police Impaler, lose the police and deliver it to the tunnel. Either character can start.\nNo direct cash reward reported.\nBilly’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Hometown Heroes awards The Lone Rider.

column3: Thrillbilly Mud Club, Kelly County. Follow Billy's text after The Impaler.
column4: Return to the mud club for Billy's finale. The reported reward is $10,000 and The Lone Rider trophy or achievement.\nBilly’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Hometown Heroes awards The Lone Rider.

column3: Andy's new house, Belville. Wait for a call and address text as Lucia after Mami Knows Best and Car Service.
column4: Finish the three Climbing the Cellerichain deliveries. Andy gives Lucia the Pure Manifestick and Cellerica cap welcome package.\nLucia only. Andy’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Puff Puff Pass awards Road to Rehabilitation.

column3: Lucia's phone, anywhere. Wait for Andy after finishing all three Cellerichain parts.
column4: Pay the reported $5,000 initiation fee through BuckMe. Switch to Lucia to receive the call.\nLucia only. Andy’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Puff Puff Pass awards Road to Rehabilitation.

column3: Andy Cellerica initiation, Lucia only
column4: After paying Andy's fee, wait for his text as Lucia. At the Belville Cellerica campus, look outside Conference Hall B for the green Cellerica Caddy that Andy introduces.\nLucia only. Andy’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Puff Puff Pass awards Road to Rehabilitation.

column3: Vice City. Cecilia sends the location to Lucia after Peach!, following an in-game delay.
column4: Recover the marked Cellerica van and drive it to Cecilia's warehouse. Reported payout $1,800 through BuckMe.\nLucia only. Andy’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Puff Puff Pass awards Road to Rehabilitation.

column3: Start at the Paper Boys warehouse after Cecilia contacts Lucia. The mission continues at Cecilia's mansion.
column4: Finish Read the Label first. Complete the warehouse sequence and find Cecilia at her mansion. Reported reward $10,000 and the Road to Rehabilitation trophy or achievement.\nLucia only. Andy’s strand does not count for Strangers & Freaks; Puff Puff Pass awards Road to Rehabilitation.

column3: After Boobie Time, look for Yasmani's job markers at Casa de Empeno, Richardson Jewelry and Donovan Banks & Co.
column4: Either character can take the jobs. Objective items unlock the Snap Gun and paid garage pickups. The reported objective-item payout is $20,000 plus any other proceeds.\nYasmani’s jobs are outside the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.

column3: Yasmani ATM jobs
column4: After Jewelry Jobs and Credit Check, either character receives the initial free robbery tip. The three full ATMs are Megamart, Casino and Xero Gas. The opportunity lasts one in-game day; missing it does not prevent subsequent paid tips. Borrow Yasmani’s 86 Rancher with a winch behind his shop or use an eligible winch vehicle. Each ATM has four cash trays. Reported combined proceeds $30,000–$40,000.\nYasmani’s jobs are outside the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.

column3: Yasmani payday loan jobs
column4: Rob 2 payday loans to unlock security-van tip service.\nOptional follow-up: after at least one payday-loan tip, ask for more tips to trigger Steal the Gold Blammer. The necklace is in the locked desk box at Vice City Gun & Pawn, Rockridge. Reported payout $15,000. Do this before That’s Where the Money Is if you want the optional job; skipping it does not block progression.\nYasmani’s jobs are outside the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.

column3: Yasmani side job
column4: Tail the Security Van. Later pay for tips to attempt the large vaults. The Chapter 3 strand is distinct from the Chapter 4 bank-vault tutorial; some guides group the later tips with the latter.\nYasmani’s jobs are outside the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.

column3: Tyrone / Kitty Litter Labs
column4: Take Out Kitty Litter: start lab-closure strand.\nTyrone’s strand has its own Spin On This! trophy, not Strangers & Freaks.

column3: Grayson, Lummox County. Jason receives the follow-up after closing enough Kitty Litter labs.
column4:
Meet Tyrone at the motel and finish his lab operation. Reported reward $10,000 and the Spin On This! trophy or achievement.
Reported: that Tyrone calls after 15 labs have been destroyed.
After the finale, Tyrone calls to offer his gold W-10 sidearm variant; collect it at his apartment.
Tyrone offers the highest reported narcotics buy rate after the lab storyline.
Tyrone supplies additional drug-theft locations. The source did all labs and the finale, so whether the latter alone unlocks these benefits is uncertain.
Tyrone’s strand has its own Spin On This! trophy, not Strangers & Freaks.

column3: Lost Vista, Scattered Pines and the 24/7 northeast of Emerald Springs.
column4:
Finish Slam Dunk; select the tips under Robberies on the map.
Lost Vista: approach the green-and-white trailer from the muddy rear. Take two pill bags from the front table and two from the bedroom.
Scattered Pines: reach the corner white trailer from behind; search by the broken refrigerator and near the TV/sofa in the back room for crystal.
24/7: enter through the rear metal door by the No Access sign. Turn into the storeroom and collect crystal from the table by green bins. The safe is optional.
Leave each search area to finish its objective. If the third tip is absent, sell the first two stashes. Put bags in the trunk at Dunk’s trailer; payment arrives through BuckMe.

column3: Gambit Bay, Mariana County, after Feng Shui. Play as Jason.
column4: Catch a stoplight parrotfish weighing more than 2 lb for Cal. The guide reports a Focus increase and the Baited My Tackle trophy or achievement.\nNot one of the eight qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands.

column3: Heathcliff Heights party at the Y Hotel, Ocean Beach, during Pool Day. Attend with one playable character.
column4: Meet Eddie at the elevator. The guide reports that agreeing to pay him costs $50,000. Refusing avoids the payment.\nReported availability after Bad Driver!; attend solo.\nNot one of the eight qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands.

column3: Hamlet, Vice-Dale County, after Lawyer Up. Lucia only.
column4: Time-sensitive. Pick up Shayna and drive her home. The outcome and reported valuables depend on the choices at Raph's house.\nReported story-order appearance after Child’s Play.\nLucia only. Earliest reported trigger: after Lawyer Up, drive near Hamlet and respond to Shayna’s message. Pick her up at prison. Optional house valuables ~ $1,500; reported peaceful outcome ~ $1,200, higher-risk outcome up to $5,000 in fenceable items. No trophy requirement.

column2: Ch4: That's Where the Money Is
column3: Cafe Orquidea, Ocean Beach, after VCIA Takedown.
column4:
Either character can meet Yasmani's marker. Follow the security van, enter the bank and finish the vault tutorial to unlock eight large-bank vault jobs.
Reported story-order appearance after Tie Up Loose Ends.
Before starting this tutorial, complete any desired Gold Blammer and small-bank tip jobs: they may be bypassed afterward. Small-bank tips become available in Chapter 4 after previous tips; Yasmani provides safe codes for a fee. The reported typical safe payout is about $20,000. These optional jobs are not required for completion.
Yasmani’s jobs are outside the eight Strangers & Freaks strands.

column3: Salton, Vice City: after Dealer's Choice; Manuel texts Jason with the Hit n Run VC street-race marker.
column4: Open Yago questline. Rent a car and finish Join a Street Race. Introduces Yago; after a few in-game days unlocks Bumper to Bumper, then timed race, then Brother to Brother. GPS map: Salton Hit N Run VC race venue; follow the quest marker.\nYago’s qualifying strand awards credit at Brother to Brother, not each individual race.\nRental costs $600–$900; first place pays $3,000. The $900 Dinka Chavos XS is the highest-rated rental.

column3: Little Cuba, Vice City: Yago's street shop; Jason only. Wait several in-game days after Join a Street Race.
column4: If marker is locked, sleep/return later. Drive Yago's 1990 Annis Elegy to Euroform Automotive; select Pro Builds > Full Kits > Custom Street Racing Build, then Performance > Boost > Nitrous Boost. Yago pays. Finish race, lose cops and meet Yago north of Vice City. Reward $500. Later he texts about the MISSABLE limited race ID 1413.\nReported story-order appearance after Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs; Jason only.\nYago’s qualifying strand awards credit at Brother to Brother, not each individual race.

column3: El Rincon Notorio restaurant BACK DOOR, Little Cuba, Vice City. Yago texts after earlier races; Jason only.
column4: Final Yago mission, after Yago’s earlier missions; the limited Race Against Yago is separately missable; delayed a few in-game days. Back him at deal in west Vice City, take bag, fight through gang and follow his car. End choice does not save Yago. Reward: KEEP his custom anime-wrapped Annis Yago's Elegy, Standout ID 3603; garage it or sell at Pay n Spray. Bag contains marked bills to fence; no direct cash payout. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks.\nReported story-order appearance after Mall Rats; Jason only.

column3: Freddie's compound on the north shore of Lake Leonida, Leonard County. Either character.
column4: Reported: the east container/tunnel entrance for the initial visit and the northeast water tower for the retest. Reported: the water tower on the initial visit, then a northwest tractor/trailer ramp on the retest if the tower is closed. Use whichever in-game entrance is accessible. Wait for Freddie's invitation between visits. Either choice completes the mission and unlocks hurricane weather. Reward conflict: Reported: $10,000; Reported: $6,250 cash for leaving or a gold Benefactor Dubsta for staying. To pursue the vehicle, stay with Freddie; verify the actual award. Counts toward Strangers & Freaks.\nA newer report recommends waiting several in-game days for the second invitation; the first-visit route uses the east-side loader/container entrance. Hurricane weather becomes available after the retest, not necessarily immediately.

column3: Meet the roadside protesters south of Vice City International Airport. Noah's follow-up is in northwest Southside by the river.
column4: Give Noah your details and wait for his text. Go alone as Jason or Lucia. Photograph the animals with the phone and follow Noah until you deliver the cage.

column3: Vice City Oceanarium, Catalan Key. Speak to Rosebud among the protesters, then meet at her marker south of the buildings.
column4: Give Rosebud your details and wait for her message. Use Jason or Lucia solo. Follow her through the Oceanarium and drive the orca transport to the marked drop-off.\nNo separate mission reward listed in the walkthrough.

column3: Watson Bay, Mariana County. Meet Tyler as Lucia after Bring Out the Chimp and Sisters of the Sea.
column4: Follow Tyler to the fracking site. Complete the valve and drill objectives, then leave with him. His follow-up opens the final Dodos mission.\nNo separate mission reward listed in the walkthrough.

column3: Emerald Springs park, Kelly County. Lucia only, after Twin Flames.
column4: Follow the green arrows toward the glass building on the park island. Take the egg to Jeff and finish the marked stops with the dodo before delivering it to Yvonne. Reported payout $5,000.\nAt the vet, the reported prompt to resist the knockout is Square / X repeatedly.

column3: Park at the south end of Ocean Beach. A poster in the Bayside Apartment lobby points to the event.
column4: Talk to the stuntman in white as Jason or Lucia. Set up the stunt and meet the AudaCity engineer afterward to start Papa Audacity's strand.\nNo direct reward reported. Give Details to the engineer; the follow-up arrives after a few in-game days.\nPapa Audacity’s qualifying strand awards credit at The Audacity finale.

column3: La Perle, Vice City. After The Unknown Stuntman, wait for the message and return as the same character.
column4:
Meet the AudaCity engineer. Finish the marked dirt-bike tests, including the final leap, and speak to the engineer again.
Avoid pink box stacks on the lower course; aim for a multiplier over x50 on the roof within about a minute. No direct reward reported.
The waiting dirt bike is reported as AudaCity Sanchez. Lower parking level course, then roof: large central jumps initially add x10; final corner ramp lands in water. Retention after the trial is not established.
Papa Audacity’s qualifying strand awards credit at The Audacity finale.

column2: Ch3: Quit Your Job, Sell Your House
column3: Peacock Bay Condominiums. After Trial by Tire, bring both Jason and Lucia to Papa Audacity's marker.
column4:
Go to the roof, help with the aerial stunt and bring Papa Audacity to the medical center. The AudaCity Sandking is a reported keep-or-sell reward.
After the Catalan Key skydive and stadium incident, carry Papa to the truck in the parking lot and drop him at Brooks Healthcare Medical Center, Southside. Keep the truck or sell it; reported $4,400 registration, buyer offer varies.
Alternate walkthrough: enter the checkerboard-floor lobby, take the elevator, climb yellow stairs to the helipad, then follow the pink aerial ring over Catalan Key. At the purple stadium court, stand on the ground beneath the canopy for the filming angle before retrieving the truck.
Papa Audacity’s qualifying strand awards credit at The Audacity finale.

column3: Use the marked AudaCity vehicles around Vice City after Quit Your Job, Sell Your House.
column4:
Finish the five dirt-bike jumps, then complete the two follow-up stunts that appear. Follow the mission markers for the full series.
First five stunts can be done in any order: Dalton statue, Leonida Power and Light, Ocean Beach garage, St. Vitus and Mastodon Sand Mill. Follow-ups: Piker Financial Center and Vice City sign. No direct reward reported.
Alternate AudaCity Sandking sighting at the West Vice-Dale Vice City Sign stunt ramp: reported scan lists Key Cloner, alarm, no tracker, $10,350 sell value and $4,400 registration. Do not count the alternate spawn as a second variant.
Detailed mission routes: Dalton sculpture from the back; LPL dirt ramp north over the canal; Ocean Beach garage roof south toward alley; St. Vitus rooftop northeast corner; Mastodon purple circle beyond yellow container and mixer. Downtown follow-up: elevator, parachute and rings. Airport follow-up: western ramps over boats toward Vice City sign. Use mission cues; these are not the 130 free-roam jumps.
Papa Audacity’s qualifying strand awards credit at The Audacity finale.

column3: Sundown Airfield, Waning Sands, Leonard County. Unlocks after completing the AudaCity stunts.
column4: Meet Papa Audacity at the airfield. Follow the flight route, climb to the marked altitude and parachute onto the yacht.\nPapa Audacity’s qualifying strand awards credit at The Audacity finale.

column3: Neo Paloma Apartments, Tequesta. Papa Audacity sends the party invitation after Catching a Whale.
column4: Find the engineers by the elevator. Sell DacityCoin through the phone before the final jump to receive the reported payout. Finish the party escape for Strangers & Freaks credit.\nReported proceeds roughly $22,350 in the elevator or $25,250 immediately before the final jump. The coin crashes if held through the finale. Party invitation follows about one in-game day after Catching a Whale.\nEither character can attend. After the rooftop pool landing, use the building on the opposite side of the pool to reach the elevator; call Papa after losing the wanted level to finish the strand.

column3: Main road in Grayson, Lummox County. Any chapter.
column4: As either protagonist, agree to an aura reading. Wait a few in-game days for Scarlet’s message, then return alone and accept a second reading. Sit in the chair to complete the encounter. No mission reward.

column3: Key Lento Mini Mart, central Key Lento, Mariana County. Jason; after Feng Shui.
column4: Before Coming Home, buy any three pink-marked products. Put the groceries in your car trunk, close it, drive home and carry them inside. Reward: relationship increase with Lucia.\nA low-cost combination is apple ($1), bread ($5) and coffee ($8).

column3: Flower stand, southern Key Lento. Jason; after Feng Shui.
column4: Buy a $10 bouquet or $25 roses before Coming Home. Delivery to the house is automatic. Reward: relationship increase with Lucia.

column3: The Siren's Chest, southern Key Lento, beside Barnacle Beauties. Jason; after Feng Shui.
column4: Order the gold chain engraved with Tommy’s name before Coming Home. The necklace can be used as collateral in Chapter 2. Reward: relationship increase with Lucia.

column3: Barnacle Beauties, southern Key Lento. Jason; after Feng Shui.
column4: Buy any haircut before Coming Home. Hair colors and beard styling are optional. Returning to an old hairstyle costs money again. Reward: relationship increase with Lucia.

column3: Manatee’s Rest bar, northern Key Lento. Jason; after Feng Shui.
column4: Accept Andy’s call from an unknown number. Ask the bartender for Andy, follow her to her car and put the clothing bag in your trunk. Bring it to Lucia’s prison pickup. Missable before her release. Reward: relationship increase with Lucia.

column3: Key Lento Community Center. Jason; after Day Release.
column4: Accept Lucia’s daytime call, arrive in a vehicle before 16:00 and drive her home. Declining or missing the deadline forfeits the mission. Reward: relationship increase with Lucia.

column3: Port Gellhorn police impound, Kelly County. Either protagonist; after Coffee Break.
column4: Find Lucia’s vehicle at the green car marker. Drive through the fence, recover her car and escape the two-star pursuit. Reward: access to Lucia’s personal vehicle.

column3: Vice City; either protagonist, after Dealer’s Choice. Open the story-task list on the map.
column4: Recover an impounded personal car using Scooter Bros (approximately $700–$900), or register a new vehicle at Pay n Spray if a garage slot is free. One recovered or registered car completes the task; both protagonists’ previous vehicles are impounded.

column3: Courtyard Bar, Stockyard, Vice City. After Heavy Lifting; bring both protagonists.
column4: Buy one drink and leave the bar area to complete the objective. Dancing is optional. Reward: relationship increase.

column3: Marked bar, Millport, Lummox County. Either protagonist; after Party Hard.
column4: Missable: complete before Power Play. Approach the rear of the bar, pursue Felipe when he flees, stop him and use Focus (L2 / LT) to talk. Choose to spare him for a later vehicle gift, or kill him for $20,000 from Andrea. If spared, wait for his message and the gift marker.

column3: Mariana County, four swamp search zones; Jason, after Down to Earth.
column4: Follow the blinking yellow lights and beeps. Recreation Area: dislodge the package in the beach tree; the other is in the water at the southern dock. Burned Houses: southern shore by the second ruined house from the east, lone burned house on north shore, and blue paddling pool near the southwest slide. Pelican Valley: two packages together near the alligators. Thorpe Adventures: enter the shed and collect the half brick; the opened package outside is empty. Deliver the bags to Donnie’s trailer. Complete before Chapter 1 ends.

column3: Avery Pawn, Port Gellhorn; either protagonist after Coffee Break.
column4: Complete the marked pawn-shop robbery, escape the wanted level and optionally sell the stolen goods at Dunk’s trailer. Cash depends on the loot. The back-room safe code can vary; 6499 is one reported code.

column3: Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn; either protagonist after Coffee Break.
column4: For Let’s Go Bowling, collect all three valuables: watch in southeast room, Gutterball Moreland 850 on northeast pool table, and contents of northeast office safe (sticky bomb). Leave the compound and escape the wanted level. The operation returns after a long cooldown, so missed valuables can be collected later.

column3: La Perle, alley behind Pay’n’Spray; either protagonist.
column4: Finish Photo/Shoot and wait a few in-game days for Dre’Quan’s message. Collect KD’s SFB 1000 motorcycle from the marked alley; keep or sell it.
